name: Amazon S3
line: Object storage for app uploads, backups, static sites, and archives.

free.text: Up to $200 credits; account suspends at 6 months, data erased after 90 days

files.math: 100 GiB of storage costs $2.30. Add $0.50 for upload requests (PUT) and $0.40 for download requests (GET). Outbound data transfer (egress) is $0.00. The total is $3.20.
